    Changelog

    scmBayesPost 0.2.9

    Performance improvements

    • gibbs_sampling_selection() and gibbs_sampling_selection_moderators() are now substantially faster when the first-stage probit is used with large datasets (tested on N = 292,199 observations):

      • Truncated normal sampling: replaced truncnorm::rtruncnorm() with a fast inverse-CDF sampler (.sample_z_star()). Treated and untreated index vectors are precomputed once before the loop, eliminating repeated ifelse dispatch across 290k+ observations per iteration. Approx 2-4x speedup on the z* block.

      • Outcome cross-products: X_block'WX_block and X_block'W are now precomputed once before the Gibbs loop since X_block is fixed across iterations. Only X_block'W y_tilde is recomputed per iteration. Z_star (the Kronecker moderator selector) is also precomputed in gibbs_sampling_selection_moderators().

      • nu_hat alignment: replaced the per-iteration data.table merge in .build_nu_hat_stacked() with a one-time integer index map (.build_nu_hat_index()). Inside the loop, stacking nu_hat is now a single vector lookup (nu_hat[nu_row_idx]) rather than a 290k-row join. Approx 10-50x speedup on that operation.

    New internal functions

    • .sample_z_star(): fast inverse-CDF truncated normal sampler.
    • .build_nu_hat_index(): precomputes the integer alignment map from X_block rows to original dta rows, used in place of the per-iteration data.table merge.
